speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A hot lane. Two men with bucklers, each of them sure he is the whole town. That is the picture. It is not a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No words for them tonight. Brooke stays up. The king stays with Garnish. I played, and I came home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The letter is still on the board. It names no day. It is not going to the Bell. Enough.
